title: Micron shares jump 17% as strong AI-driven outlook lifts market value above Meta
summary: Micron Technology surpassed Meta Platforms in market valuation for the first time, driven by a strong forecast. The shares rose 18.4% to $1.236, giving a market cap of $1.398 trillion, slightly above Meta's $1.392 trillion, but below Tesla's $1.4 trillion.
